activity.role: Humanitarian campaigner addressing landmine prohibition in London
activity.notes: The Royal Family documents her June 1997 London address at the Royal Geographical Society advocating a ban on anti-personnel landmines, and 1997 Angola/Bosnia visits. The United Kingdom association refers specifically to this London advocacy, not a claim she was sovereign or that her activity only lasted in 1997. Cultural/public humanitarian advocacy receives existing representative Domain v2 culture; do not claim she single-handedly enacted the Ottawa Treaty.
